assetInfo: Info (include gender and pronouns for characters)
customPreserveRulesHint: Source matches must remain verbatim on the same translated line. Use this for line prefixes, dialogue brackets, and project-specific control codes.
startupSuggestions: After importing a glossary, you can find translations that do not follow it in one click. Glossary edits can also be applied in bulk, but preview them first to avoid replacing ordinary words.
Generate a character bible before translation to keep names, voices, and pronouns consistent across chapters, then extend it as new characters appear.
When a folder contains many text files, translate the folder as a batch. Files are queued across subagents, so you do not need to prepare prompts one by one.
Before accepting a proofreading suggestion, compare the source, current translation, and proposed translation to make sure it does not introduce an unwanted change.
Lower-cost models are useful for bulk first drafts, while stronger models are better for final proofreading. You can choose separate models for the main Agent and its subagents.
You can pair the LAN link with Cloudflare Tunnel to control Translation Workshop securely over the public internet while away from home.
subagentModelUnavailable: No configured model found; subagents will follow the main Agent
statusNote: Ready for TXT, EPUB, prompt generation, report-to-HTML review, and the embedded Agent OS.
companionGuideLine1: Yaona offers guidance: choose the source file and output folder first. Source files stay read-only.
companionGuideLine2: Set the language pair, style, output folders, and split size in Advanced.
companionGuideLine3: Choose split or Monte Carlo proofreading; both modes remain host-validated.
requiredSourceOutput: Source file and output folder are required.
requiredReviewReport: Review report and output folder are required.
agentUnavailable: Agent OS could not start. Check that the runtime is available.
agentOfficialApiHelp: Common providers use preset endpoints and model lists; only credentials and model need changing.
agentCustomApiHelp: Custom API is for OpenAI-compatible local/proxy endpoints; set Base URL and model manually.
projectOpenedNoHtml: Project folder selected, but no recent HTML was found. Open an HTML file manually or generate one.
reviewFormatFallback: The AI report failed format validation. A repair prompt was generated.
reviewHtmlOpened: Review HTML opened inside the app.
sourceImmutable: Source files are read-only and never modified. Prompts require backup before overwriting translations.
modeTranslateOnly: Without a translation file, this is translation-only mode.
modeCompare: With a translation file, this is proofreading / comparison mode.
noArtifacts: No candidate translation artifacts found under AI_translation/.
artifactsNeedOutputDir: Set an output folder to discover agent artifacts.
repairPromptReady: Repair prompt ready in the prompt box. Send it to the agent to fix the candidate format.
